name: Ilha Verde Rent a Car
verdict: Ilha Verde Rent a Car is a company of Grupo Ilha Verde, an Azorean automotive group under the family management of founder Antero Gil Rêgo. Nothing found.
note: Azorean car-rental company (Ponta Delgada, founded 1971) on the sleeve of Santa Clara's 2026-27 home shirt; listed among the club's official sponsors. Rating note: family-run private group per the group's own site; no record found.
